breaking_changes: Node package major gaps detected from package.json against npm latest: async 0.x->3.x, body-parser 1.x->2.x, cron 1.x->4.x, express 4.x->5.x, jsonwebtoken 5.x->9.x, influx 4.x->5.x, socket.io/socket.io-client 1.x->4.x, mongodb 2.x->7.x, xmlbuilder 2.x->15.x, archiver 0.x->8.x, stream-buffers 2.x->3.x, csv 0.x->6.x, handlebars 3.x->4.x, nodemailer 1.x->9.x, send 0.x->1.x, uglify-js 2.x->3.x, uuid 2.x->14.x, winston 1.x->3.x, winston-logstash 0.x->2.x.
Solr configuration is pinned to luceneMatchVersion 4.9 and uses legacy schema.xml/solrconfig.xml constructs requiring compatibility review before moving to a modern Solr.
MongoDB driver 2.x to 7.x affects connection, cursor, CRUD callback behavior, and server compatibility.
Socket.IO 1.x to 4.x affects server/client protocol compatibility and authentication middleware.
Express 4.x to 5.x and body-parser 1.x to 2.x affect middleware/error handling and route behavior.
Winston 1.x/logstash transport 0.x to current versions affect logger construction, transport APIs, and monkey-patched transport internals.
